title: Dev loosing Accu_Chek Combo pump pairing after phone restart
symptom: On a new Pixel 6 with Android 13, the user was unable to pair the Accu_Chek Combo pump with Ruffy. After moving to the DEV version and pairing with the V2 driver, pairing works but only on the second try. After every phone restart, AAPS loses the pairing, showing the pump as unpaired, although the pump remains listed among Bluetooth known devices. Pairing again only works after removing the pump from the list.
evidence_quote: with every phone restart so far AAPS is loosing the pairing, showing the pump as unpaired.
